en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a detailed architectural view of a Romanesque-Gothic cathedral entrance. The image focuses on a side portal with a gabled porch supported by columns, flanked by sculpted lions at the base, and a conical-roofed structure beside it. Above runs a decorative arcade frieze. Printed Italian text at the bottom identifies the subject as the cathedral in Trento and the portal toward the apse. There is also handwritten blue ink across the lower margin.
